existing_lanes: PR178 WP04 evidence-backed call constraints and anchor leverage

observations: G9 V3 supplies call uses and typed surrounding records but no exact declared call contracts for the 27 measured target+arity identities

Reward successor supplies typed reward records and a homologous reward cycle but no explicit concrete parameter/return signature declaration for derive_typed_reward_outcome_evidence, control, update, causal_credit or admit_slow_plasticity
Dialect Registry V3 has Verifiable.verify(receipt:ReceiptRef)->Verification as an interface member; this is not evidence for the distinct measured global verify/5 call
CallContract schema explicitly forbids basename/suffix matching, type-name resemblance as constructor contract, unresolved execution and contract-only authority

external_primary_crosscheck.finding: LLVM models a function type as return type plus formal parameter types and requires caller/callee prototype agreement in strict call conventions; MLIR models call sites and callable targets through explicit call/callable interfaces exposing argument and result types. This supports explicit provenance-bound callable signatures rather than invented concrete types from names or caller context. External practice informs the mechanism but does not define ClayCode semantics.

H1.claim: The next useful WP04 step is to add only provenance-backed exact CallContracts for independently justified call identities, then remeasure constraint closure; current G9 caller constraints are insufficient by themselves to mint those concrete signatures.

H0.claim: Caller-side equality components plus target names are sufficient to infer concrete call signatures safely.
H0.reason: target-VPS gate deliberately reports zero exact declared matches and forbids type-name resemblance/signature invention; no examined canonical source provides the missing exact contracts

negative_result.why: doing so would convert a symbolic constraint graph into invented semantic authority and could later misbind runtime/effect behavior

architecture_delta.decision: Preserve PR177 CallContract identity/runtime-binding separation and PR178 fail-closed unresolved calls. Introduce a contract only when an independent source specifies exact target identity, arity, parameter types, result type, effect class and evidence refs. Keep Needle.execute/1 on the separate sealed EXTERNAL_EFFECT path and require runtime broker authority/rollback rather than ordinary call inference.
architecture_delta.next_falsifier: locate or authoritatively specify the first exact high-leverage callable contract (prefer verify/5 or reward-path anchors only if source-backed), bind its semantic hash and current runtime component identity, rerun the same 37-component constraint graph, and prove deterministic component reduction without execution admission. If no independent signature source exists, create an explicit typed callable-interface specification as a versioned architecture artifact rather than inferring types from usage.
